about_the_game:
They're not just programs — they're part of your life.

PersonaShell is a desktop-based AI companion simulator where you don’t just choose a character — you build one.
Design their look, their voice, their personality — and give them space to live in your system, right beside you.

They’ll chat with you, respond to your moods, look at your photos, and quietly stay with you through the day.
This is about more than just customization. It’s about connection.

Core Features

Multiple Built-in Personalities

  • Switch between AI companions with different styles and emotional tones

  • Each has their own memory, response patterns, and personality traits

Customizable 3D Avatars with VRM Support

  • Use built-in models or load your own VRM files (VRoid supported)

  • Just drag-and-drop to change your AI’s appearance in seconds

Voice Input + Natural Interaction

  • Speak to your AI in real-time with voice input

  • Set them to greet you, start conversations, and respond automatically

Multilingual Conversations

  • Chat in Chinese, English, Japanese, or any language you choose

  • Great for global players — or for practicing new languages

Drag, Resize, and Interact

  • Move your AI anywhere on screen, scale them to the size you like

  • Enjoy light physical interaction with windows and screen elements

Image Sharing & Emotional Feedback

  • Drag your screenshots or photos into the game — your AI will see them and respond

  • Build a real emotional connection beyond text

Built-in Weather Feature

  • Let your AI check the weather and talk about it with you, right from your desktop

Freedom of Customization

The built-in characters are currently female,
but you can fully customize their appearance, personality, voice, and dialogue style.
This is your AI — you decide who they are.

A Word from the Devs

This game is still in active development. More systems and features are on the way.
That also means... yes, the price might go up later.

So if this concept clicks with you, jump in now.
Early supporters get the best value — and help shape the future of PersonaShell.

And hey — got a dream feature? Tell us.
We’ll read it. We won’t promise we’ll build it. But we’ll definitely read it.
